subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw treat Volcano Engine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-like keys when a user selects a general Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: The code shows a real split between general and coding endpoints, but only a credentialed vendor check or maintainer policy can decide whether this is a routing bug, an entitlement-specific diagnostic gap, or expected provider separation.

options.title: Validate Lite route first
options.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/Coding Plan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys on Coding Plan
options.body: If Lite keys are valid only for `volcengine-plan`, keep the endpoint split and add earlier diagnostics so users do not discover the mismatch as a runtime 401.

options.title: Support shared key on both endpoints
options.body: If the same key should work for general models too, treat this as a runtime/auth bug and fix the credential or request path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite route first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/Coding Plan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses bundled provider ownership, auth aliases, setup/runtime compatibility, and product diagnostics where the history is strongest.
